item.title: Betting on Bots: A Deep Dive into Botnet Campaigns
item.description: As someone immersed in cybersecurity every day, botnets have always intrigued me with their evolving tactics and increasing sophistication, especially when they are Linux-based. Recently, I happened to come across some of the latest botnet campaigns. In our analysis, we explored how these bots are weaponized for distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, malware distribution, and crypto mining operations. Additionally, we discussed how attackers are using increasingly automated techniques to monetize their botnets at scale.
